function.name: default_function
function.description: This function provides default behavior when specific functionality has not been implemented. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

action.description: The action to be executed by the function. Should be a descriptive verb.

verbose.description: A flag to indicate whether to run the function in verbose mode, providing detailed logs.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds the function should wait before timing out.

function.name: add_mtnards_server
function.description: Adds a new MTNA Rich Data Services (RDS) server to the environment configuration, allowing it to be recognized and utilized by the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

nickname.description: An informal, easy-to-remember name for the server.

host.description: The server's hostname or IP address. Should be in the format 'hostname.com' or '192.168.0.1'.

api_key.description: A unique API key for secure access to the server.

function.name: add_postgres_server
function.description: Adds a new PostgreSQL server configuration to the environment, allowing for future database operations on this server. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

nickname.description: A unique and recognizable name or alias for the server, used for easy identification.

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server.

port.description: The network port on which the PostgreSQL server is listening.

database.description: The default database name to connect to on the PostgreSQL server.

username.description: The username for authentication with the PostgreSQL server.

password.description: The password associated with the username for authentication with the PostgreSQL server.

function.name: dartfx_help
function.description: Provides guidance and assistance to the user on a particular topic within the DartFX application. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

topic.description: The specific topic or feature within DartFX the user needs help with, such as 'chart analysis' or 'trade execution'.

verbose.description: Whether to provide detailed assistance. If true, the help provided will include comprehensive information and examples.

language.description: The language in which the help is to be provided.

function.name: list_servers
function.description: Retrieve a list of all servers within a specified environment, optionally filtered by server type. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

server_type.description: The category of servers to list. If not specified, all server types are included.
